In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the coadsorption of lactoferrine with the DPPC lipid monolayer is a dynamic process, and that the extent of lactoferin coadsorption depends on the surface pressure in the monolayer.
the coadsorption of lactoferrins into the DPPC phospholipid layer was found to be a function of the surface pressure of the lipid monolayers.
